subject: Follow-up: Healvia data handling — confirmation on model updates opt-out and log retention
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: María López <maria.lopez@healvia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Healvia data handling — confirmation on model updates opt-out and log retention

Hi María — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end: 

Call summary:
- Use case: clinical knowledge retrieval inside Healvia admin portal (internal tooling).
- Main ask: strict controls around PII, 14-day log retention, EU residency for logs, and explicit opt-out of any model improvement or training using Healvia data.

Proposed immediate actions for Redwood: 
1) Flag your account with a "no_model_learning" customer-level restriction — this will prevent any routing of customer data to model training pipelines.
2) Enable request-level PII redaction for known identifiers (names, MRNs) by default; we will share the redaction patterns for review.
3) Set log retention to 14 days for request/response traces; store traces in our EU region.
4) Share a draft Data Processing Addendum (attached) and a link to SOC2 evidence for your security team.

Please confirm the above items or let us know changes. Once you confirm, I'll loop in legal to push the DPA via DocuSign and have engineering apply the account flags.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Healvia_v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-Report-Link.txt (link stub)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: María López <maria.lopez@healvia.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Healvia Procurement <procure@healvia.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 17:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Healvia data handling — confirmation on model updates opt-out and log retention

Karthik,

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Healvia's position: we require:
- No use of any Healvia customer data to improve, fine-tune, or otherwise train Redwood models (including aggregated training).
- Request/response logs retained for a maximum of 14 days and stored in the EU.
- PII redaction applied automatically; we'll share a short list of identifiers to prioritize (SSNs, MRNs, full names).

Two asks from procurement/security: can you provide a signed DPA and a copy of the most recent SOC 2 report (or a read-only link)? We'll need both to complete our vendor onboarding.

If you can send the DPA to procure@healvia.com via DocuSign, that will accelerate the review.

Best,
María López
Head of Product
Healvia
maría.lopez@healvia.com

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Healvia data handling — confirmation on model updates opt-out and log retention

María — appreciated. I've taken the following steps and listed what we need from your side: 

What we've done (internal):
- Applied a temporary "no_model_learning" tag to the Healvia account (engineering ticket RD-8721). This prevents any automatic routing of Healvia data to our model improvement pipelines.
- Configured the default log retention to 14 days and scoped storage to our EU region (will be finalized after DPA executed).
- Enabled the PII redaction prototype for your workspace; Jonas will share patterns and sampling results next week.

What we are sending now:
- DPA draft attached (Redwood_DPA_Healvia_v1.pdf). We'll push this as a DocuSign envelope once you give approval to procure@healvia.com.
- SOC2 report link (SOC2-Report-Link.txt) that points to a read-only bucket for your security team.

Next steps (asks for Healvia):
1) Please confirm the redaction identifier list (SSN, MRN, full name, email) so engineering can tune filters.
2) Approve the DPA and sign via DocuSign when received.
3) Let us know the procurement contact and PO process; we'll include Marissa (CS lead) and Priyom (legal ops) on the final routing.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call next week with Jonas (security engineer) to walk through the redaction approach and evidence flow.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/en/recipient?envelopeId=12345-HEALVIA
Drive folder with DPA and evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cD_Healvia-DPA

Thanks — will stand by for confirmation so we can close the legal loop and lock the configuration.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Karthik — thanks. Procurement has sign-off to proceed on those terms. They asked that the DPA be sent to procure@healvia.com for signature; PO will follow after DocuSign completes. Redaction list below is confirmed (SSN, MRN, full name, email, phone).

Please proceed to send the DPA via DocuSign and we will route internally. Confirm when the account-level flag is final and when SOC2 access is available to our security reviewer.

Best,
María
